generation_prompt.prompt: Create a clean {{size}} educational or informational social media card for {{brand_name}}. Style: structured editorial layout with clear visual hierarchy and maximum legibility. Background: a clean light tone or {{color_palette.background}}. Brand logo at top. An icon badge, number bullet, or decorative element beside the headline. Body copy in a well-structured, readable layout. CTA or website URL at bottom.
generation_prompt.important_instruction: Layout: BRAND LOGO top-center (small, clean), icon badge or numbered step to the left of the headline, headline large and clear in {{color_palette.text}}, body copy in clean columns with generous line spacing, accent divider in {{color_palette.primary}}, CTA or website text at bottom in {{color_palette.primary}}. Typography must be clean and highly legible — this is an information card, not a decorative image. No busy background.
